proposal.root_cause: Commit 3f7a9bc removed DB_URL from the api-config ConfigMap (deploy/demo/configmaps.yaml), so the api container exits 1 with "DB_URL not set" and CrashLoopBackOff.
proposal.rationale: Pod api-65b4fc86b7-nwn4f is CrashLoopBackOff (exit code 1, restartCount 2) and its logs print "DB_URL not set"; app.py in the api-code ConfigMap exits 1 when DB_URL is missing. The live api-config ConfigMap contains only LOG_LEVEL. Git history shows commit 3f7a9bc48ada542381ef80f12784669bbb5297f4 ("config: tidy api configmap") deleted the line "DB_URL: redis://redis:6379" from deploy/demo/configmaps.yaml, so restoring that exact line reverts the breaking change. Value is taken verbatim from that commit's diff.
proposal.verify: After merge and Argo CD sync of demo-app, the api-config ConfigMap in namespace demo contains DB_URL: redis://redis:6379; pod api-65b4fc86b7-* restarts with exit code 0, becomes Ready (readiness /healthz returns 200), and CrashLoopBackOff/BackOff events stop.

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: api
  namespace: demo
  labels:
    app: api
    app.kubernetes.io/version: "1.0.0"
  annotations:
    repair.example.dev/source-path: deploy/demo/api.yaml
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: api
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: api
        app.kubernetes.io/version: "1.0.0"
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: api
          image: python:3.12-alpine
          command: ["python", "/app/app.py"]
          ports:
            - containerPort: 8000
          env:
            - name: APP_VERSION
              value: "1.0.0"
          envFrom:
            - configMapRef:
                name: api-config
          volumeMounts:
            - name: code
              mountPath: /app
              readOnly: true
          readinessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /healthz
              port: 8000
            periodSeconds: 5
          livenessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /healthz
              port: 8000
            initialDelaySeconds: 10
            periodSeconds: 10
          resources:
            requests:
              memory: 96Mi
              cpu: 50m
            limits:
              memory: 128Mi
              cpu: 500m
      volumes:
        - name: code
          configMap:
            name: api-code
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: api
  namespace: demo
  labels:
    app: api
    app.kubernetes.io/version: "1.0.0"
  annotations:
    repair.example.dev/source-path: deploy/demo/api.yaml
spec:
  selector:
    app: api
  ports:
    - name: http
      port: 8000
      targetPort: 8000
